categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. focuses primarily on two main business segments: anti-HIV pharmaceutical products and human-derived protein products. The company develops, manufactures, and sells innovative anti-HIV drugs, including two Class 1 new drugs, and human-derived protein raw materials and formulations, including urokinase and related products. It also engages in pharmaceutical manufacturing and research services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs proprietary resin adsorption technology for efficient extraction and purification of human-derived proteins from urine, enabling large-scale industrial production with reduced environmental impact. It also develops small molecule chemical drugs using advanced synthesis, formulation, and quality control technologies, including patented processes for raw material synthesis and compound crystallization. The company maintains GMP-compliant production facilities for both raw materials and finished pharmaceutical products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical formulation companies purchasing human-derived protein raw materials, hospitals and healthcare providers for anti-HIV drugs, and distributors for over-the-counter products. The company serves the domestic Chinese market extensively and is expanding into international markets, particularly in Africa and Southeast Asia, targeting HIV patients and healthcare institutions. It also collaborates with academic and clinical research institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yangzhou and Nanjing. It has begun international market expansion, notably in African countries such as Zanzibar and Nigeria, and Southeast Asia. The company holds GMP certification for production facilities compliant with international standards to support overseas market entry.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical operates both upstream and downstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain. It controls the supply of human-derived protein raw materials, manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and produces finished drug formulations. The acquisition of Nanjing Nanda Pharmaceutical enables integrated operations from raw material extraction to drug formulation, enhancing vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in anti-HIV therapies, focusing on developing new chemical entities such as the integrase inhibitor ACC017 and long-acting HIV prevention drugs. It also advances human-derived protein drug development, including clinical trials for new indications like stroke treatment. R&D efforts include expanding the anti-HIV drug pipeline with both innovative and high-end generic drugs, supported by substantial investment and patent filings.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including innovative anti-HIV drugs, human-derived protein raw materials, and finished formulations. The company also earns income from licensing, technology transfer, and government subsidies. Sales channels include direct sales, distributor networks, and online pharmacy platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical is positioned as a leading domestic innovator in the Chinese anti-HIV drug market, with two approved Class 1 new drugs and a broad R&D pipeline. It competes with imported drugs and domestic generic manufacturers, aiming to replace imports with high-quality, cost-effective alternatives. In the human-derived protein sector, it holds a leading market share, especially after acquiring Nanjing Nanda Pharmaceutical, which dominates the urokinase market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 417.8 million, a slight increase of 1.57% year-over-year. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 141.2 million, reflecting increased R&D and sales expenses. The company’s total assets grew by 7.04% to RMB 1.87 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D accounting for over 25% of revenue, indicating a strong growth and innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its dual-core strategy combining innovative anti-HIV drugs with human-derived protein products, offering comprehensive treatment options for HIV patients. Its anti-HIV drugs feature high efficacy, safety, low drug interaction, and high resistance barriers, supported by clinical evidence and inclusion in national treatment guidelines. The proprietary resin adsorption technology and integrated supply chain provide cost advantages and quality assurance in human-derived protein products. The company also highlights its commitment to serving unmet clinical needs and expanding patient access domestically and internationally.
